newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse closes for Chulalongkorn Day.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse closes for Chulalongkorn Day.

text.p: The Thai bourse closed on Wednesday on a public holiday to observe the Chulalongkorn Day.

The SET index rose 9.53 points to 958.05 on sluggish 3.5 billion baht turnover on Tuesday, its fifth consecutive but cautious daily advance after the market took a heavy beating in the previous two weeks. The index gained a combined 52.71 points on a technical rebound since October 16.

Brokers said investors were holding out hopes Thailand's November 17 election would bring in a new government with more support from the business community that would give the market a psychological boost. -- Vithoon Amorn (662)-2529950-3
